title: My Wife Is Wagatsuma-san
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Aoshima, an unpopular second-year high-school student who wants a girlfriend, suddenly wakes up ten years in the future married to Wagatsuma Ai, the prettiest girl in school. Back in the present, he keeps slipping forward in time and finds that the future changes with what he does now, as other girls enter the picture. It is a shounen ecchi romantic comedy that reviewers say turns more dramatic later and ends abruptly.
life_message: What you choose and how you treat people today shapes the future you get.
